decisions.reason: As a bread product close to the core bakery range, it likely uses existing recipes, ingredients, and sales channels, so the cost of keeping the option open is low and there is no clear negative evidence yet.

The guided historic mill tour fits the firm's experience-based offer and differentiation strategy, but because it needs staff time and visitor demand can be more uncertain than baked goods, we would keep it with somewhat higher exit risk while learning.

A sweet pastry is strongly aligned with the firm's confectionery capabilities and can be tested at relatively low incremental cost, so real-options logic favors retaining it until demand becomes clearer.
